notice.title: Limits on debt collection contacts
notice.aiSummary: The Retail Conduct Authority proposes limiting debt collection calls to 7 times in 7 days per debt and requiring firms to honor consumer requests for written-only contact. This is a consultation open for comments until January 15, 2027, with proposed effectiveness on June 1, 2027.
notice.aiReason: This notice applies to firms that collect consumer debts including debts they originated, and Brivanta Bank collects its own consumer debts.

text:
RETAIL CONDUCT AUTHORITY FICTIONAL REGULATOR - SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE
Consultation: Limits on debt collection contacts
Notice number: RCN-2026-023
Issued by: Retail Conduct Authority
Published: 2026-11-12
Effective date: 2027-06-01
1. Who this applies to
Firms that collect consumer debts, including debts they originated.
2. Background
The Authority proposes limits on how often collectors may call consumers. Comments are invited until 15 January 2027.
3. Requirements
3.1 A firm must not call a consumer about a particular debt more than 7 times within 7 days.
3.2 A firm must honor a consumer's request to be contacted only in writing.
4. Status
This is a consultation. The requirements above are proposals and are not yet in force.
Synthetic document written for a Snowflake example. The regulator, rule and numbers are fictional.

obligations.text: A firm must not call a consumer about a particular debt more than 7 times within 7 days.
obligations.controlDesc: Dialer rule limits calls about one debt to 7 in 7 days; exceptions reviewed weekly
obligations.reason: Policy POL-CRD-02 states "Calls about one debt are limited to 7 in any 7-day period" which matches the obligation's threshold exactly, and Control CTL-192 enforces this by limiting "calls about one debt to 7 in 7 days" with weekly exception reviews that would detect breaches.

obligations.text: A firm must honor a consumer's request to be contacted only in writing.
obligations.controlDesc: Monthly check that written-contact-only requests are flagged in the dialer
obligations.reason: Policy POL-CRD-02 states "Requests to be contacted only in writing are recorded and honored" which directly meets the obligation, and CTL-193 monitors compliance by checking that written-contact-only requests are flagged in the dialer.
